entries.title: 2 new Rav Asher Weiss quote cards
entries.summary: Two new כמדומני moments joined the quote-cards page (q15, q16). One: don't wait for a great mitzvah — go home tomorrow morning, pray with a minyan, hear the Torah reading (Megillah for individuals on Shabbat, 00:20:10). Two: hard to say that was the custom — two gedolim lived in the same era in Jerusalem and each ruled differently (Purim Meshulash, 00:10:19). Each card plays the shiur audio from the exact timestamp.

added.quote: כמדומני — לא ממתינים למצוה גדולה: צא הביתה מחר בבוקר, התפלל בציבור, שמע קריאת התורה.
